entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I... I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's more of a preference, I guess. It's a beautiful device, but it's just not for me. The thing is, I tried to do this last week. I was within the 10-day window, on day 9, but there was a huge website error. I just couldn't print the return label.
I see. You're saying the website was preventing you from making the return?

Yes, exactly. I kept getting a '500' error page. I even took a screenshot because I was so worried this would happen. The whole system was down, and now I'm on day 17 and I was so scared I'd be stuck with it. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really needed this money back.

I understand your frustration completely, and I can confirm we did have a known issue where our system was down for maintenance, which affected the returns portal. Let me just pull up your account and our current policy.

Okay, I have your order here. It looks like it was delivered 17 days ago. Let's see... yes, according to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? Are you sure? That's... that's amazing! What a relief. I was so worried I had missed my chance because of the website problem.

Not at all. You're perfectly fine. I've gone ahead and processed the return authorization for you. I just sent an email with a pre-paid shipping label. Simply pack the VeloBand in its original box and drop it at any post office.
Thank you, David! Thank you so much. You've really helped me out today. I was so stressed about this.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a happy New Year.
